entries.title: Ezekiel 11:1
segments: ¶Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD'S house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:2
segments: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these [are] the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:3
segments: Which say, [It is] not near; let us build houses: this [city is] the caldron, and we [be] the flesh. {It is...: or, It is not for us to build houses near}

words.text: . {It is...: or, It is not for us to build houses near}

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:4
segments: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:5
segments: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the LORD; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, [every one of] them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:6
segments: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:7
segments: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they [are] the flesh, and this [city is] the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.

words.text: : but I will bring you forth

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:8
segments: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:9
segments: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

words.text: And I will bring you out

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:10
segments: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:11
segments: This [city] shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; [but] I will judge you in the border of Israel:

words.text: This [city] shall not be your caldron
, neither shall ye be the flesh

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:12
segments: And ye shall know that I [am] the LORD: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that [are] round about you. {for ye...: or, which have not walked}

words.text: you. {for ye...: or, which have not walked}

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:13
segments: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?

words.text: And it came to pass, when I prophesied

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:14
segments: ¶Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:15
segments: Son of man, thy brethren, [even] thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, [are] they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the LORD: unto us is this land given in possession.

words.text: wholly, [are] they unto whom the inhabitants

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:16
segments: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.

words.text: ; Although I have cast them far off
, yet will I be to them as a little

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:17
segments: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:18
segments: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.

words.text: thither, and they shall take away

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:19
segments: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:20
segments: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

words.text: them: and they shall be my people
, and I will be their God

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:21
segments: But [as for them] whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:22
segments: ¶Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel [was] over them above.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:23
segments: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which [is] on the east side of the city.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:24
segments: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:25
segments: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed me.
